snip.t: Immunosuppressants should not be used because they suppress immunity

snip.t: Autoimmune diseases (e.g., SLE, rheumatoid arthritis) treated with immunosuppressants.

Medication history: *Current antibiotics, antiretrovirals, antimalarials, immunosuppressants, recent drug allergies?* — Prior antibiotics select resistant flora; drug interactions affect choice of agents.
Intrinsic Renal: Treat the specific cause (e.g., antibiotics for pyelonephritis, immunosuppressants for glomerulonephritis, stopping nephrotoxic drugs).
Medication / allergies: Recent antibiotics, immunosuppressants, drug allergies — Influences choice of empiric agents and need for desensitisation
Medication & allergies: Current drugs (especially immunosuppressants, antiretrovirals), drug allergies — Guides choice of empiric agents and avoids adverse reactions.
Medications: *Recent antibiotics, immunosuppressants, antihistamines?* — Certain drugs (e.g., ceftriaxone) can cause immune complex reactions; antihistamines may mask early signs.

Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP): IVIG or PE (induction) → oral steroids or steroid‑sparing immunosuppressants (azathioprine, mycophenolate) — Physiotherapy, occupational therapy
